question: When is self-rest deficient and reversal present?
premises: self-rest may be deficient in the opposite
reversal occurs in eagerness for self
awakening makes rest in known small
inference: deficiency and reversal arise with self-eagerness and awakening
plain_english: Self-rest may be deficient in the opposite; reversal occurs, for when one is awakened in eagerness for self, rest in the known is small.
